decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records the required explanation that the subcontract amount is lower than the full allocated program budget, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
Confirming the meaning of the allocated-budget field does not change service days, session times, or start and end dates.
The allocated-budget interpretation does not alter the requirement for a signature in the subcontractor section.
Distinguishing the full program allocation from the subcontract amount does not change the existing session-count calculation, per-session rate, or labor total.
The allocated-budget-field interpretation does not change whether the salary and wages support sheet must be included.
